mentions.name: Ato – Explore together
mentions.description: This social exploration app tracks where the user and their friends have collectively traveled by dividing the global map into H3 hexagons. It derives visited locations from photo and workout metadata, awards points, enables comparisons between everyone, and displays all users' travels on a shared global map.
mentions.audience: Friends tracking their collective travels, with open sign-ups for the general public
mentions.source_excerpt:
working on a Coop exploration app, already on AppStore - https://apps.apple.com/jp/app/ato-explore-together/id6757285141.

Basically tracking where my friends and I have collectively been by dividing the global map into H3 hexagons. The using photo and workout metadata to get the locations, giving points and doing comparisons between everyone.
